name: 2.25Cr-1Mo Steel Inelastic Constitutive Models and Fatigue-Creep Benchmark
description: Project benchmark evaluating inelastic constitutive models and fatigue-creep life prediction methods for 2.25Cr-1Mo steel.
evaluation_method: error metrics (RMSE / MAE / MAPE for life and deformation predictions)
reputation: A domain-specific benchmark known within materials science and creep/fatigue modeling communities but not widely used in general ML benchmarking.
notes: Specialized, non-LLM benchmark with experimental variability; results depend strongly on test conditions and constitutive model assumptions; limited public benchmark infrastructure and potential small/heterogeneous datasets.
